heading: We push in both directions.
text: Plenty of shows exist to defend Christianity against culture. We'd rather be honest about both.

cards.title: The culture around us
cards.text: What's shaping how we think about identity, rest, sex, politics, and suffering, and what Jesus has to say about it.

cards.title: The Christian culture within us
cards.text: The assumptions, blind spots, and comfortable habits we've picked up along the way, held up to Scripture.
